meta.title: API Error Simulation & Stress Test Reporting
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Create stress tests that simulate API errors and generate comprehensive reports to validate error handling and track stress test results over time.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: API error simulation exists for: 500, 429, 408, connection refused
Each error handled gracefully: retry logic, no crash, errors logged with context
Comprehensive stress test report generated with all scenarios, metrics, pass/fail

key-tasks.task: Implement 500 error simulation (mock, verify retry, backoff)
Implement error context logging (order_id, symbol, no sensitive data)
Implement report aggregation from all stress tests

architecture-context.pattern: Retry with exponential backoff for transient errors. Respect Retry-After header for 429 responses. Log context without sensitive data.
architecture-context.constraint: System must survive any single API failure without data loss (NFR7)
All order state transitions logged for audit (NFR10)

technical-specifications.spec:
async def simulate_500_error(broker, operation): mock_response = httpx.Response(status_code=500, json={"error": "Internal Server Error"}) with patch.object(broker._client, 'post', return_value=mock_response): with pytest.raises(BrokerError): await operation()
async def simulate_429_error(broker, operation, retry_after=5): mock_response = httpx.Response( status_code=429, headers={"Retry-After": str(retry_after)}, json={"error": "Rate limit exceeded"} ) # Verify retry happens after delay
